title: Windstorm and hail
text: Covers physical loss caused by windstorm or hail. A percentage deductible applies.

title: Flood exclusion
text: Loss from flood, surface water or rising water is not covered. Flood cover is separate.

title: Coverage limit
text: The most we pay for any one loss is the dwelling coverage limit on the declarations.

title: Notice of loss
text: Give prompt notice of a loss and take reasonable steps to protect the property.
